title: LLM Tool Calling: Let AI Call Your Code (Claude API)
description:
What if your AI could call your code? Here's how. 🔧

✅ Add a tools list with a name and input_schema
✅ Ask a question the tool can answer
✅ Read the tool_use request with jq

Day 4 of Build AI Apps. Next up: Day 5, Handle Rate Limits with Retry Backoff.
Follow for a new short every day and ship your own AI app.

#shorts #ai #coding #programming #llm #aitools #tutorial
comment: Curl or Python: which would you call tools from? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: the model only asks for the tool. Your code runs it and sends the result back.
